Admission is quota-limited: at most 1162 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the haven. The glacier index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 159 account operation therefore ties up 30 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
